bugs.description: Process ID generation uses uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] which could theoretically collide
bugs.suggested_fix: Use full UUID or add timestamp: f'{process_type}_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}'

bugs.description: ProcessInfo.logs list can grow unbounded in long-running processes
bugs.suggested_fix: Add max log limit: if len(self._processes[process_id].logs) > 1000: self._processes[process_id].logs.pop(0)

bugs.description: No automatic cleanup of old completed/failed processes - could cause memory leak
bugs.suggested_fix: Add periodic cleanup: async def cleanup_old_processes(max_age_hours=24)
